name: Single Scattering Approximation with Precomputed Terms
definition: A rendering approximation that considers only single scattering effects and uses pre-computed direction-independent radiance components to improve efficiency.
summary: Single Scattering Approximation with Precomputed Terms is a rendering method that uses deterministic ray marching and precomputed direction-independent radiance to enable differentiable density optimization, replacing stochastic sampling for improved efficiency.
